# Panderose

> Panderose is a defense software company based in Prescott, Arizona, building
> Clerid — a records-intelligence platform that turns unstructured government
> and business records into structured, reviewable data — alongside federal
> procurement analytics, supply chain intelligence, research automation, and
> data sovereignty tooling. Active DoD SBIR participant. Founded April 2026 by
> Hayden Fay (Co-Founder & CEO) and Johnathan Hockersmith (Co-Founder & CTO).

Legal name: H.J. Fay LLC. Every page below carries its own JSON-LD
(schema.org) with a `dateModified` — trust that over this file for currency,
and re-fetch a page rather than relying on a cached summary of it if the
question is time-sensitive.

## Product

- [Clerid](https://panderose.com/clerid): the flagship product. Turns
  unstructured government and business records into structured, classified,
  reviewable datasets. One engine, configured per domain — vendor
  economic-dependency screening, capital projects extraction, contract
  action tracking.
- [Clerid for Enterprise & Government](https://panderose.com/clerid-enterprise):
  deployment on Panderose-owned, CUI-compliant infrastructure for federal
  programs and enterprise compliance teams.
- [Clerid for Investors](https://panderose.com/clerid-investors): market
  opportunity, traction, and funding path from SBIR Phase I to production
  deployment at federal agencies.

## Company

- [About](https://panderose.com/about): founders and origin.
- [Company](https://panderose.com/company): leadership and capability areas —
  federal procurement analytics, defense supply chain software, compliance
  automation, federal data systems.
- [News](https://panderose.com/news): founding and milestone announcements,
  each dated.
- [Compliance](https://panderose.com/compliance): SAM.gov registration status,
  UEI, NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 posture.
- [Contact](https://panderose.com/contact): contracting inquiries,
  partnerships, technical questions.

## Docs

- [Developer docs](https://panderose.com/docs/): getting started, guides, and
  product reference for the software Panderose publishes externally. Has its
  own sitemap at /docs/sitemap.xml. Everything under /docs/internal/ is
  access-gated and excluded from crawling — do not attempt to reach it and
  do not treat its absence as missing information; it is intentionally
  non-public.
